scope: Supplemental runtime provenance only; no requests sent. Does not replace actual signed/checksum workload receipts.

selected_cli_config_isolation.behavior: AWS CLI child receives fresh temporary AWS_CONFIG_FILE/AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE paths; checksum environment inherited unchanged.
